_meta.description: Hypothalamic neuronal populations targeted by perturbation experiments.
curation_policy: marker_genes are MGI (mouse) symbols and are listed ONLY where the gene genuinely defines or reliably co-marks the population.

neurotransmitter uses the SCHEMA.md enum (GABA, glutamate, dopamine, serotonin, histamine, peptidergic, mixed, unknown) and is ['unknown'] wherever the fast transmitter phenotype is not firmly established for that population.

cre_lines lists ONLY driver lines the curator is confident exist under approximately that name. Candidate lines the curator could not vouch for are mentioned in prose in 'notes' instead of being asserted here. No JAX stock numbers are given because none were verified.
synonyms exist for query expansion and string matching ONLY and carry no biological claim.
curation_confidence refers to the non-synonym biological content (markers, transmitter, nucleus), not to the synonym list.

arc_agrp.label: ARC AgRP/NPY neurons
arc_agrp.notes: Best-characterised population in this corpus. GABAergic (Vgat-expressing) is firmly established. 'NPY neurons' is a looser label: NPY is expressed outside ARC, so NPY-only papers need region confirmation.

arc_pomc.label: ARC POMC neurons
arc_pomc.notes: POMC neurons are transcriptionally heterogeneous with both GABAergic and glutamatergic subsets, hence 'mixed' rather than a single transmitter. Cartpt co-marks a large fraction but not all. Pomc-Cre also labels some NTS POMC neurons and (for Tg lines) non-neuronal POMC lineages, which matters for whole-body phenotypes.

arc_kisspeptin.label: ARC kisspeptin (KNDy) neurons
arc_kisspeptin.notes: Tac2 is the mouse symbol for neurokinin B (human TAC3). Glutamatergic phenotype is reported but weaker evidence than for AgRP GABA, so confidence is medium. Kiss1-Cre also labels the AVPV/RP3V kisspeptin population, which is a distinct population (see avpv_kisspeptin); papers must be read for which one was targeted. Pdyn-IRES-Cre and Tac2-Cre are far from ARC-specific.

avpv_kisspeptin.label: AVPV/RP3V kisspeptin neurons
region_raw_synonyms: rostral periventricular area of the third ventricle
avpv_kisspeptin.notes: Added because Kiss1-Cre work is split between this and the ARC population and conflating them would be an error. Fast transmitter phenotype not firmly established to the curator's knowledge.

arc_th.label: ARC tyrosine-hydroxylase (dopaminergic/TIDA) neurons
arc_th.notes: Classical TIDA neurons are dopaminergic and control prolactin. However Th-IRES-Cre labels ARC cells that are not uniformly fully dopaminergic (variable Slc6a3/Ddc expression), and some ARC TH neurons are reported to be GABA/glutamate co-releasing. Listed as dopamine with medium confidence.

arc_ghrh.label: ARC GHRH neurons
arc_ghrh.notes: Peptidergic identity is definitional; the fast transmitter phenotype is not firmly established to the curator, hence 'unknown'. A Ghrh-driver line is used in the GH field but the curator could not vouch for its exact allele name, so cre_lines is deliberately empty rather than guessed.

arc_sst.label: ARC somatostatin neurons
arc_sst.notes: Sst-IRES-Cre is pan-brain, so region confirmation is essential. Note that the somatostatin population controlling GH secretion is classically periventricular/anterior (PeV), not arcuate; papers must be read for which was targeted. Fast transmitter phenotype not firmly established here.

arc_tbx3.label: ARC Tbx3 neurons
arc_tbx3.notes: Tbx3 is a transcription factor required for ARC neuropeptidergic identity and is expressed across AgRP and POMC cells rather than marking one functional population; so this is a developmental/identity handle, not a transmitter-defined population. Published perturbations use floxed Tbx3 plus AAV-Cre rather than a Tbx3 driver line, so cre_lines is empty.

vmh_sf1.label: VMH SF1 (Nr5a1) neurons
vmh_sf1.notes: Nr5a1 marks the dorsomedial/central VMH. Glutamatergic identity is well supported. Sf1-Cre also acts in adrenal cortex and gonads in some lines, which is a confound for endocrine readouts; this must be checked per paper.

vmh_bdnf.label: VMH BDNF neurons
vmh_bdnf.notes: VMH is predominantly glutamatergic, so glutamate is inferred at the nucleus level rather than demonstrated for the Bdnf-defined subset: medium confidence. Most published perturbations are region-targeted Bdnf deletion (floxed Bdnf plus AAV-Cre or stereotaxic knockdown), not driver-line targeting, so cre_lines is empty rather than guessed.

dmh_lepr.label: DMH leptin receptor (LepR) neurons
dmh_lepr.notes: Lepr-Cre is expressed in many hypothalamic and extrahypothalamic sites, so region restriction (usually by AAV injection site) defines the population. Transmitter phenotype of the DMH LepR subset not firmly established to the curator.

dmh_bdnf.label: DMH BDNF neurons
dmh_bdnf.notes: Thinly characterised relative to VMH BDNF. Transmitter unknown; no driver line asserted.

pvh_crh.label: PVH CRH neurons
pvh_crh.notes: Apex of the HPA axis; the neuroendocrine subset projects to the median eminence. Crh-Cre also labels extrahypothalamic CRH populations (BNST, CeA, Barrington's), so region confirmation matters.

pvh_oxt.label: PVH oxytocin neurons
pvh_oxt.notes: Magnocellular (neurohypophysial) and parvocellular (central-projecting) subsets have different physiology and are frequently not distinguished in abstracts. SON oxytocin neurons are a separate anatomical population often studied together with PVH.

pvh_avp.label: PVH vasopressin neurons
pvh_avp.notes: Overlaps anatomically with SON AVP neurons for osmoregulatory readouts, and is distinct from SCN AVP neurons (see scn_avp). Abstract-level text often does not say which.

pvh_trh.label: PVH TRH neurons
pvh_trh.notes: Controls the HPT axis. 'peptidergic' is definitional; the fast transmitter phenotype is not firmly established here. A Trh driver line is used in the field but the curator could not vouch for its exact name, so cre_lines is empty rather than guessed.

pvh_mc4r.label: PVH MC4R neurons
pvh_mc4r.notes: Downstream target of ARC AgRP/POMC input; strong energy-balance literature. Glutamatergic identity follows from PVH being predominantly glutamatergic plus direct reports: medium-high, recorded as glutamate with medium confidence.

pvh_sim1.label: PVH Sim1 neurons
pvh_sim1.notes: Sim1 is a developmental transcription factor marking most of PVH (plus SON and parts of the amygdala), so it is a broad nucleus-level handle rather than a cell type. Glutamate recorded at medium confidence on nucleus-level grounds.

pvh_nos1.label: PVH Nos1 neurons
pvh_nos1.notes: Nos1 overlaps partially with CRH, OXT and TRH subsets, so this entry is not disjoint from the other PVH entries. Transmitter unknown.

lha_orexin.label: LHA orexin/hypocretin neurons
lha_orexin.notes: Glutamatergic (Vglut2-expressing) is well supported. An orexin-tTA / Hcrt-tTA transgenic system is also widely used for conditional ablation (orexin-DTA); the curator is confident such a system exists but has not verified an exact allele name, so only the Cre line is listed.

lha_mch.label: LHA MCH neurons
lha_mch.notes: Transmitter phenotype is contested: MCH neurons have been reported as glutamatergic and as GABA-marker-expressing, with subset heterogeneity. Recorded as 'unknown' rather than taking a side.

lha_vgat.label: LHA GABAergic (Vgat) neurons
lha_vgat.notes: Transmitter is definitional (Slc32a1 = Vgat). This is a transmitter-class population, not a cell type, and is heterogeneous; it overlaps partially with lha_mch and other LHA peptidergic cells.

lha_vglut2.label: LHA glutamatergic (Vglut2) neurons
lha_vglut2.notes: Transmitter is definitional (Slc17a6 = Vglut2). Overlaps lha_orexin.

poa_warm_sensitive.label: Preoptic warm-sensitive neurons (VMPO/MPA)
poa_warm_sensitive.notes: This is a FUNCTIONAL definition (warm-activated) onto which several molecular markers have been mapped by different groups: Qrfp-expressing VMPO neurons, and Adcyap1(PACAP)/Bdnf co-expressing VMPO neurons. These marker sets are not established to be the same cells, so marker_genes here is a union of candidate markers, not a conjunction. A Qrfp driver line is used in this literature but the curator could not vouch for its exact name, so only Adcyap1-2A-Cre is listed. Transmitter heterogeneous/unknown.

poa_galanin.label: Preoptic galanin neurons
poa_galanin.notes: Two partly distinct literatures use this label: sleep-promoting VLPO/MnPO galanin neurons and parental-behaviour MPOA galanin neurons. GABAergic is reported for the sleep-active population; recorded at medium confidence and not asserted for all galanin preoptic cells.

scn_vip.label: SCN VIP neurons
scn_vip.notes: Essentially all SCN neurons are GABAergic, so GABA here is on firm nucleus-level grounds. VIP marks the retinorecipient core and mediates network synchrony.

scn_avp.label: SCN AVP neurons
scn_avp.notes: Distinct from pvh_avp despite sharing the Avp marker and the Avp-IRES-Cre driver; disambiguation requires the region. Circadian output rather than osmoregulation.

tmn_histamine.label: TMN histaminergic neurons
tmn_histamine.notes: The sole source of brain histamine; Hdc is definitional. Many TMN histamine neurons also express GABA markers; GABA co-release is reported but not listed as established here.

zi_gaba.label: Zona incerta GABAergic neurons
zi_gaba.notes: Subthalamic rather than strictly hypothalamic; included because the feeding/sleep perturbation literature treats it alongside LHA. Transmitter definitional.

mbh_ikkb.label: Mediobasal hypothalamic IKKbeta/NF-kB signalling
mbh_ikkb.notes: NOT a neuronal population. This is a signalling-pathway perturbation (constitutively active IKKbeta or Ikbkb deletion delivered to MBH, sometimes in neurons, sometimes in microglia/astrocytes) that the aging-hypothalamus literature treats as a hypothalamic manipulation. Kept so the harvest can find that literature; any downstream record must mark the cell type honestly as not a defined population. marker_genes are pathway genes, not cell-identity markers.
